Choose which Bible text the reader opens. The two English editions are separate public-domain translations, not official liturgical texts: chapter and verse numbering can differ from the Konkani edition, and bookmarks are best effort across editions. Sources and licences are in About.
The World English Bible, Catholic edition, is a complete Bible in English — 73 books — in the Catholic book order.

The app redistributes the text unmodified, with HTML formatting only. The name World English Bible is a trademark of eBible.org, used here because the text itself is unchanged. This app is not produced or endorsed by eBible.org.

The Douay-Rheims Bible, American Edition of 1899, is a complete Bible in English — 73 books — translated from the Latin Vulgate, and is in the public domain.

The app redistributes the text unmodified, with HTML formatting only. The translation follows the Latin Vulgate rather than the Hebrew text, so psalm and verse numbers can differ from the Konkani edition: Psalm 22 here is Psalm 23 in Hebrew-numbered Bibles.
